claim_text: The team-biomedic critique (Q30) that ocular biology (N5) should merge into biophysics/biomechanics is REJECTED by a unanimous composite-audit (3/3 lenses, keep-as-is): the project already separates an orthogonal physics-law/data axis (13 RAG data-niches RN1-RN13) from a scientific-domain axis (6 niches N1-N6); the biomedic conflates them, and merging ocular would collapse Test 5 (cross-field operation needs a structurally distinct field). Two amendments accepted: a metabolic-role discriminator (signaling-scaffold vs metabolic-general-function, applied additively to the corpus_manifest schema) and the recognition that ocular morphology already routes to RN9. The taxonomy decision is queued for a human gate; additive enrichments (label-collision fix, crosswalk, interaction_table, schema) were applied without reorganizing the taxonomy.
human_gate_rationale: The taxonomy decision touches the scientific-domain niche set + Test 5 instrumentation; per ADR-0013 process/taxonomy changes are human-gated (governance-proposal gp-2026-06-11-niche-taxonomy-q30, self_applied:false). The audit verdict is a recommendation, not a self-applied decision.

Per CLAUDE.md §5, framework_applied is self-report.
